best_idea: Pick an aftermath pose from progress and clamp it to the top pose, and run looping clips on a real-time deadline with a jittered period that is separate from the simulation day clock.
decision_why: Keep the aftermath-by-progress rule and the deadline loop with a per-cycle random period; drop the 100 ms sprite cadence and the grid snap, because a 3D clip runs on the render clock. The shape fits creature clips (row 7); the sprite-era tick does not.
acceptance: A creature killed in the Pit shows its death pose by time since death (index rises with time and stops at the top pose), and its idle loop advances on the render clock; a test asserts the pose index never decreases with time since death and never passes the top pose.
